subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
A rectangular sheet of paper which measures $6 \mathrm{~cm} \times 12 \mathrm{~cm}$ is folded along its diagonal (Diagram A). The shaded areas in Diagram B are then cut off and the paper is unfolded leaving the rhombus shown in Diagram C. What is the length of the side of the rhombus? <image1>
Choices:
A:$\frac{7}{2} \sqrt{5} \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$7.35 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$7.5 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$7.85 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$8.1 \mathrm{~cm}$
